invariants.rationale: clusteringPlan is de-referenced shortly after, so it is expected not to be null.
schema is passed and may be required by later logic, and is likely required to not be null.
instantTime parameter is supplied and used as a clustering instant, expected to be non-null and not empty as this is a meaningful identifier.
getInputGroups() is called on clusteringPlan and then iterated over; it is expected not to be null.
getStrategy() is called on clusteringPlan and subsequently used, so it is expected not to be null.
